001package io.github.kale_ko.ejcl;
002
003import io.github.kale_ko.bjsl.elements.ParsedObject;
004import io.github.kale_ko.bjsl.processor.ObjectProcessor;
005import io.github.kale_ko.ejcl.exception.ConfigLoadException;
006import io.github.kale_ko.ejcl.exception.ConfigNotLoadedException;
007import java.io.IOException;
008import org.jetbrains.annotations.NotNull;
009import org.jetbrains.annotations.Nullable;
010
011/**
012 * An abstract class that all unstructured configs extend from
013 * <p>
014 * Contains all the logic for getting/setting values
015 *
016 * @version 5.1.0
017 * @since 3.0.0
018 */
019public abstract class UnstructuredConfig {
020    /**
021     * The ObjectProcessor to use for serialization/deserialization
022     *
023     * @since 3.0.0
024     */
025    protected final @NotNull ObjectProcessor processor;
026
027    /**
028     * The data being stored
029     *
030     * @since 3.0.0
031     */
032    protected @Nullable ParsedObject config;
033
034    /**
035     * Create a new Config
036     *
037     * @param processor The ObjectProcessor to use for serialization/deserialization
038     *
039     * @since 3.0.0
040     */
041    protected UnstructuredConfig(@NotNull ObjectProcessor processor) {
042        this.processor = processor;
043    }
044
045    /**
046     * Get a path being stored and load it if necessary
047     *
048     * @param path The path to get
049     *
050     * @return The value being stored
051     *
052     * @since 3.0.0
053     */
054    public @Nullable Object get(@NotNull String path) {
055        if (!this.getLoaded()) {
056            try {
057                this.load();
058            } catch (IOException e) {
059                throw new ConfigLoadException(e);
060            }
061        }
062
063        if (this.config == null) {
064            throw new ConfigNotLoadedException();
065        }
066
067        return PathResolver.resolve(this.config, path);
068    }
069
070    /**
071     * Get a path being stored
072     *
073     * @param path The path to get
074     *
075     * @return The value being stored or null
076     *
077     * @since 3.5.0
078     */
079    public @Nullable Object getCached(@NotNull String path) {
080        if (!this.getLoaded() || this.config == null) {
081            throw new ConfigNotLoadedException();
082        }
083
084        return PathResolver.resolve(this.config, path);
085    }
086
087    /**
088     * Set a path being stored
089     *
090     * @param path  The path to set
091     * @param value The value to set
092     *
093     * @since 3.0.0
094     */
095    public void set(@NotNull String path, @Nullable Object value) {
096        if (!this.getLoaded() || this.config == null) {
097            throw new ConfigNotLoadedException();
098        }
099
100        PathResolver.update(this.config, path, value, true);
101    }
102
103    /**
104     * Get if the config is loaded
105     *
106     * @return If the config is loaded
107     *
108     * @since 3.0.0
109     */
110    public abstract boolean getLoaded();
111
112    /**
113     * Load the config
114     *
115     * @throws IOException On load error
116     * @since 3.0.0
117     */
118    public void load() throws IOException {
119        this.load(false);
120    }
121
122    /**
123     * Load the config
124     *
125     * @param save Weather to save the config after loaded (To update the template)
126     *
127     * @throws IOException On load error
128     * @since 1.3.0
129     */
130    public abstract void load(boolean save) throws IOException;
131
132    /**
133     * Save the config
134     *
135     * @throws IOException On save error
136     * @since 3.0.0
137     */
138    public abstract void save() throws IOException;
139
140    /**
141     * Close the config
142     *
143     * @throws IOException On close error
144     * @since 3.0.0
145     */
146    public abstract void close() throws IOException;
147
148    /**
149     * Get if the config is closed
150     *
151     * @return If the config is closed
152     *
153     * @since 3.0.0
154     */
155    public abstract boolean isClosed();
156}
